sloka: एतत् श्रुत्वा शुभम् वाक्यम् भरद्वाजो महा मुनिः ।राघवस्य ततः वाक्यम् अर्थ ग्राहकम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-५४-२७॥
transliteration: etat śrutvā śubham vākyam bharadvājo mahā muniḥ ।rāghavasya tataḥ vākyam artha grāhakam abravīt ॥2-54-27॥

translations.english: On hearing the auspicious words of Rama conveying his intention, the great sage Bharadwaja replied to him thus:
